channel.title: Web3 Hub
channel.description: Web3 Hub reports crypto news: Bitcoin and Ethereum, exchanges, DeFi protocols, stablecoins, regulation, security incidents and network upgrades.

item.title: Zcash activates NU7, cutting target block time to 25 seconds
item.description: Zcash activated NU7 at block 3,543,405, cutting target block spacing to 25 seconds and adding fee reserves that begin supporting mining rewards in 2031.

item.title: FBI links $6 billion Binance theft to North Korea
item.description: The FBI says North Korea’s TraderTraitor group stole more than $6 billion from Binance in an Oct. 29 attack and is urging crypto firms to block related transactions.

item.title: Berachain bridge approvals set how much a contract can spend
item.description: A token approval lets a bridge contract spend a stated amount; it does not itself move funds, and any unused allowance can remain active after the transfer.

item.title: Schroders launches emerging-markets bond strategy on Solana
item.description: Schroders has launched tokenized exposure to its emerging-markets bond strategy on Solana through Centrifuge, giving investors blockchain-based shares in a feeder fund.

item.title: FBI links $6bn Binance theft to North Korea
item.description: The FBI attributed the Oct. 29 theft of more than $6 billion from Binance to North Korea’s TraderTraitor group and urged crypto firms to block linked funds.

item.title: Binance says fake job interview preceded $6.34 billion hack
item.description: Binance says a fake September job interview helped attackers compromise staff systems before a $6.34 billion theft, with independent security reviews now planned.

item.title: Arbitrum Council Moves $30M in Binance Hack Funds
item.description: Arbitrum moved 8,425 ETH and 74.56 million ARB tied to Binance’s hack into a frozen wallet, where only an ArbitrumDAO vote can authorize their release.

item.title: Binance Reopens More Crypto Withdrawals After $6.3B Hack
item.description: Binance is restoring withdrawals in stages after its $6.3 billion hack, with more assets scheduled to reopen as the exchange checks each network.

item.title: FBI ties $6B Binance theft to North Korea’s TraderTraitor
item.description: The FBI says North Korea’s TraderTraitor stole more than $6 billion from Binance on Oct. 29 and urges crypto firms to block wallets as laundering shifts to ether.

item.title: Binance to resume withdrawals after $6.3 billion hack
item.description: Binance says it will restart withdrawals in phases on Nov. 1 after a $6.3 billion security incident, with major networks first and more assets to follow.

item.title: Binance suspends withdrawals after $6.3 billion security breach
item.description: Binance says a security breach had an estimated $6.3 billion impact, with about $3 billion frozen; deposits and withdrawals were suspended during its investigation.

item.title: Binance hit by $6.3bn hack as analysts point to North Korea
item.description: Binance says hackers stole about $6.3 billion from its hot wallets, while analysts suspect a North Korean group and the exchange works to recover funds.

item.title: Coinbase adds Ripple’s RLUSD across its trading platforms
item.description: Coinbase added Ripple’s RLUSD across retail and institutional platforms, giving customers access to the dollar stablecoin on three networks at launch.

item.title: How to set a SushiSwap V3 price range
item.description: Sushi V3 lets liquidity providers set lower and upper token prices; the right range balances fee activity against the risk of going inactive as price moves.

item.title: Aviva tokenizes £22 billion sterling fund on XRP Ledger
item.description: Aviva Investors and Ripple put a tokenized share class of the £22 billion Sterling Liquidity Fund on XRP Ledger, with £50 million invested by Aviva.

item.title: Ripple says OCC approved national trust bank for RLUSD
item.description: Ripple says the OCC gave its national trust bank final approval on Oct. 26, adding federal supervision for RLUSD reserves while issuance stays with a New York trust company.

item.title: Aviva, Ripple tokenize £22 billion sterling fund on XRP Ledger
item.description: Aviva Investors and Ripple launched a tokenized share class of Aviva’s £22 billion sterling fund on the XRP Ledger, adding on-chain access to its money market fund.

item.title: Aviva puts £22bn sterling fund share class on XRP Ledger
item.description: Aviva Investors and Ripple launched a tokenized share class of the £22 billion Sterling Liquidity Fund on XRPL, with £50 million invested by Aviva at launch.

item.title: Solana’s Alpenglow upgrade targets 150ms transaction finality
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on Oct. 21, targeting finality in 150 milliseconds; users keep their wallets and fees as payments and exchange deposits can settle sooner.

item.title: Tether wins 15 commitments for Bitcoin mining toolkit
item.description: Tether says 15 Bitcoin mining operators, equipment makers and pools will build integrations for its open-source MDK, which aims to connect software across systems.
